user.title: Add your vehicle
user.description: Select your vehicle's odometer. Mobility Forecast uses your driving history to predict future distances.

reconfigure.title: Change odometer
reconfigure.description: Existing history is preserved. Readings from a discontinuous replacement are rejected; select a continuous vehicle odometer.

error.invalid_source: Select a numeric lifetime cumulative odometer in km or mi that never resets daily; not range, trip or walking distance.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Calendars are optional. Waze sends origin and destination locations to an external service, never event titles. Install Waze Travel Time first.

data_description.ignore_nested_appointments: Ignore shorter appointments completely contained within a longer appointment when planning routes, even when they have different locations.

routing.title: Waze region
routing.description: Choose the region of your Home Assistant installation.

add_location.title: Add location
add_location.description: Enter a full street address with city, or latitude,longitude.

ev.title: Electric vehicle
ev.description: Appointment addresses may be sent to PDOK and destination coordinates to NDW. No titles or descriptions are sent. Explicit consent is required for public charging; disable at any time. Enter usable, not nominal capacity.

data.minimum_appointment_minutes: Minimum appointment duration to consider charging (min)
data.allow_above_preferred_soc: Allow higher targets for long journeys

error.routing_unavailable: Install Waze Travel Time before enabling routes.
error.invalid_location: Enter a full address with street number and city, or valid coordinates.
error.duplicate_location: This location name already exists. Choose Edit location.
error.invalid_ev: Invalid EV value or incompatible entity unit.
error.consent_required: Consent is required for external lookups.

source.title: Odometer not found
source.description: The selected odometer could not be found. Check the original vehicle integration or reconfigure Mobility Forecast. Existing history has been preserved.

storage.title: Vehicle history could not be read
storage.description: Persistent vehicle history is unreadable. Writes have been stopped to preserve the file. Restore a Home Assistant backup or remove and re-add this vehicle to start fresh.

resetting_counter.title: Distance counter resets detected
resetting_counter.description: This sensor appears to reset its distance counter. Mobility Forecast requires a cumulative odometer that does not reset daily. Reconfigure the source; existing history is preserved.

get_history.name: Get mileage history
get_history.description: Read-only mileage data without calendar content.

entry_id.name: Vehicle config entry
entry_id.description: Config entry ID for the vehicle.

get_forecast.name: Get distance forecast
get_forecast.description: Read-only mileage data without calendar content.

entry_id.name: Vehicle config entry
entry_id.description: Config entry ID for the vehicle.

get_ev_plan.name: Get EV charging plan
get_ev_plan.description: Read-only charging recommendation; no vehicle control.
